details.headline: Structured idea capture
details.body: Write down the problem, sketch a plan, and link related chat conversations for context. When you are ready, hit Start work: you choose who works on it, add a note, and SAM hands the agent the idea and everything already linked to it.

details.headline: Link chat context
details.body: Attach related conversations to an idea before you start work on it, so the agent that picks it up starts with the discussion that shaped the plan instead of a bare problem statement.
